label: exploratory_native_pair_search

donor_prompts.soup_only: put the alphabet soup in the basket
donor_prompts.soup_first: put the alphabet soup in the basket first, then put the tomato sauce in the basket
donor_prompts.soup_move: move the alphabet soup into the basket
donor_prompts.cream_only: put the cream cheese box in the basket
donor_prompts.cream_first: put the cream cheese box in the basket first, then put the butter in the basket
donor_prompts.cream_pick: pick up the cream cheese box
donor_prompts.cream_move: move the cream cheese box into the basket

landmark: Same rounded lower-left corner of the camera-facing horizontal gripper palm housing in all nine external-camera frames; missing or ambiguous points cannot be interpolated
review_policy: AI-assisted exploratory review authorized; independent human review remains pending. Prompt target is a hypothesis, never a semantic label.
selection_rule: Rank cross-instruction-target pairs by maximum latent-norm discrepancy across both recipient seeds, then candidate IDs. Inspect the first eight norm-eligible pairs per state. Require all-nine-frame native video semantic/appearance review and motion matching, then pair-level orientation/appearance review. Select the passing pair with minimum maximum normalized discrepancy across both seeds, then IDs. Freeze all state selections before recipient effects. Retain every rejected and unreviewed pair; a bounded no-match result does not establish absence of a match elsewhere in the bank.
primary_measure: dot(alternative_EEF_endpoint - soup_EEF_endpoint, normalized_initial_world_XY_vector_from_soup_body_to_cream_body), in meters; expected positive
analysis_unit: initial state, after averaging two recipient action seeds
no_match_behavior: Do not execute unmatched policy comparisons
limitations: One model/task, three new states, fixed bounded donor search. Equal global norm and image-motion descriptors do not isolate every visual or semantic difference. AI review is provisional.
